text.tspan: SRS-based logical interaction model. Boundary / API / control lifelines represent responsibilities, not unspecified code classes, methods, endpoints or HTTP status codes. UI labels and messages are translated into English for these diagrams; SRS message IDs are retained.
Preconditions: valid session, required role, active Student account; JWT authentication under Section 5.2.1. E1 applies to both initial loading and retrieval of additional entries.
